message.text: The webhook delivery workers do not use NATS or RabbitMQ. They consume from an in-process buffered channel with four workers. PostAsync enqueues messages.

r04.
Neither NATS nor RabbitMQ is used; there is no external broker or declared queue. Webhook workers consume an in-process Go channel, `asyncPostQueue` (buffer 128), started in `init` with 4 goroutines in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. `PostAsync` enqueues; each worker calls `Post` to HTTP-deliver the payload.
